title: Herby German Fritters
description: A crispy, flavorful snack made with a blend of German and herby spices, perfect for a quick bite.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Open fritter package and separate fritters.
In a separate bowl, mix together herby seasoning, show peas, off-white vinegar, and german mustard.
Dip each fritter into the bowl and coat with the herby mixture.
Carefully place coated fritters into the hot oil.
Fry for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove fritters from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
